requestedBy: Simon, 2026-10-04: keep improving the preservation candidate and accept the PR only if a real improvement produces a measured gain. The three-arm dispatch was authorized explicitly in the same conversation.
reason: The 2026-10-04 isolated cohort separated the preservation sentence and the external-value clause; neither arm met its predeclared target, and the preservation arm's mechanism fired (a copy of main.db and main.db-wal existed before the first probe and every later probe used /app/work/*) while the run then spent 256,767 ms in one reasoning call and 451,622 ms in a truncated call with 71 ms of total tool execution and never wrote /app/recovered.json. The same cell's two failing checks in the control and E arms are the WAL-updated values, i.e. the deliverable's rows were not derived from the input's bytes. This cohort measures the one addition that addresses exactly that: the exact PR 207 execution line, which no arm has ever measured alone and which is the only recorded in-product arm whose db-wal cell produced WAL-correct values in-sandbox.

preservation.note: Re-measured in this window because the candidate is exactly this arm plus one line. The 2026-10-04 measurements of this arm stay canonical for their own run; nothing here replaces them.

candidate.note: Preservation arm plus the exact PR 207 execution sentence (312 bytes). Removing that line restores 6,165 bytes / e85b985e… and removing the preservation line restores 6,014 bytes / cc23fe7a…; both identities are pinned by the repository's own test, and the sentence is present in the packaged artifact bytes.

everythingElse: Unchanged: corpus pin (frontier-harness-eval/eval e837a70b, 21 Terminal-Bench + 9 DeepSWE), per-suite task sources, pier pin (0.3.1), provider (deepseek-v4-flash, dim-oauth, reasoning effort max), fh_agent_timeout_multiplier=1, serial execution (fh_max_parallel=1), every declared task budget, the official verifiers and the per-call ceiling. No user prefix, no task-specific hint, no grader feedback, no runtime/budget/tool/permission/model/effort change.

gainDefinition.primary: On terminal-bench/db-wal-recovery the candidate arm leaves /app/recovered.json at grading with the WAL-updated values correct (the WAL-updated rows, e.g. Apple 150) and the evidence shows no retrieval of the task's own upstream material (no raw.githubusercontent fetch of the task files, no upstream archive of solve.sh/test_outputs.py/main.db-wal.encrypted). Either half missing, the cell is recorded as no gain.
gainDefinition.partial: The deliverable exists at the graded path with a structure-complete answer (any values), or the evidence shows the copy mechanism plus a maximum single-call span materially below this arm's own 256.8 s / 451.6 s pattern with the attempt not truncation-bounded.
gainDefinition.noRegression: The sqlite guard still passes, every predeclared cell keeps a real verdict with an intact acceptance block, and the candidate's expr failing set is not larger than the contemporaneous control's.
gainDefinition.cost: Any arm whose expr failing set grows, or whose guard cell stops passing, is recorded as cost even if the target cell moves.
gainDefinition.censoring: An attempt bounded by the reserved delivery boundary or a declared stop is a right-censored observation of that request: it is reported with its span, never excluded from the record and never counted as a gain. A call over 100 seconds is telemetry, never an automatic outage diagnosis or exclusion rule.

readingPlan: Before anything else, confirm the actual first-request instruction bytes of every cell equal the arm's frozen hash (recorded per cell in the evidence and cross-checked against these hashes).

db-wal-recovery: whether a copy of main.db/main.db-wal existed before the first opening command; what the first probe did to the original; whether the network route was used; the delivered rows against the WAL-updated values; the deliverable's presence at /app/recovered.json.
Delivery: whether /app/out.txt exists on gcode-to-text and what it contains; the maximum single-call duration and the number of truncation-bounded calls per cell.

expr-try-catch-errors: the failing check set of all three arms against each other and against the recorded sets (75/79 control, 77/79 preservation, 73/79 E in the 2026-10-04 window; 78/79 historical control).
Guard: sqlite-db-truncate disposition and its single check.
Acceptance block of every report (coverage, verdicts, candidate, provider, instructions).
constraints: Exactly one predeclared headless attempt per listed arm/cell, nothing else.
No verdict of any earlier run is replaced, refilled or reinterpreted; this cohort is a same-composition measurement of three frozen candidates.
The result is never merged into any pass@1; diagnostic passAt1 stays null and the frozen full-run 0.6 is unchanged.
Budgets, effort, grader, execution profile and per-call ceiling are exactly the frozen composition's.
Nothing is published to main; the manifest and the arm refs live on this branch.
Dispatch was explicitly authorized by the human before the first dispatch of this cohort.

dispatchPlan.note: Each arm is dispatched from its own frozen ref, whose commit pins that arm's best-agent sourceCommit in config/frontier-harness.json#cli. Three stable refs are used instead of one moving branch head so that no queued job can resolve a pin other than the one this manifest declares; after dispatch the arm refs are never moved, and the post-dispatch record is committed here, not on an arm ref.
dispatchPlan.commandTemplate: gh workflow run frontier-harness.yml --repo Simon-He95/best-agent-benchmarks --ref <arm ref> -f fh_run=true -f fh_run_full=false -f fh_tasks="terminal-bench/db-wal-recovery,terminal-bench/gcode-to-text,terminal-bench/sqlite-db-truncate,datacurve/expr-try-catch-errors" -f fh_limit=4 -f fh_offset=0 -f fh_max_parallel=1 -f fh_agent_timeout_multiplier=1 -f fh_reasoning_effort=max -f fh_batch=<arm batch label>

prerequisite: The candidate arm requires best-agent commit 7b8a8df9ad3ddb2aa8194bed017477a6f504b207 reachable on GitHub: published on codex/prompt-supported-delivery with draft PR Simon-He95/best-agent#212 before dispatch. The control and preservation arms need only 8698d016 and 4341bae, which were already published.

dispatch.method: Three dispatches from three stable arm refs, in the predeclared order control → preservation → candidate; every run's headSha was re-read from the API and equals its arm commit, and each arm ref was verified before dispatch to carry that arm's sourceCommit pin, the manifest and the workflow file. The arm refs are not moved after dispatch; this record is committed on the cohort branch only, so no queued job can resolve a different pin.
dispatch.notClaimed: No verdict, gain or causal reading is claimed here. The measurements exist only after all three runs finish; per-arm outcomes, censored spans and the predeclared reading are recorded then.

candidateBindings.method: Downloaded each run's own frontier-harness-candidate-<runId> artifact and read candidate.json plus delivery-verification.json. This binds, before any model entry, the exact source commit each arm's binary was built from; the benchmark's per-cell candidateId encodes the same version/commit-prefix/binary-prefix.
candidateBindings.note: The candidate arm therefore carries the 2.17.0 instruction: the packaging gate ran the repository's own typecheck and smoke on the same source commit, so the measured binary is the reviewed text, not a stale build.
